two-point-hospital game sourced

Two Point Hospital

A hospital management game and spiritual successor to Theme Hospital in which the player builds rooms, trains staff with traits and qualifications, and cures comic illnesses across a chain of hospitals.

2018Two Point StudiosManagement / tycooncluster c0117 mechanics
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

core loop

build and decorate rooms -> hire staff with traits and train qualifications -> patients flow from GP to diagnosis to treatment -> cures earn money and reputation -> research and Kudosh unlock items -> earn stars to open the next hospital

design notes

Two Point Hospital keeps Theme Hospital's room-blueprint and diagnosis-pipeline structure and adds a deeper staff layer: every hire has personality traits, a specialisation, and trainable qualifications, so the training room is a second production line beside the clinical one. Room prestige rises with room size and decoration and feeds staff happiness, which links interior design to staff retention. Progress spreads across many hospitals with one-to-three-star goals, and items unlock with Kudosh, a currency earned from challenges rather than money. Assistants can run marketing campaigns (proposed mechanic advertising-awareness).

Theme Hospital

uses

Diagnosis and treatment

Patients start in a GP's Office and move through further diagnostic rooms until diagnosed, then to a treatment room; illnesses are comic, such as Light-Headedness and Mock Star.

core
uses

Building placement

Rooms are drawn and furnished with required machines, plus corridors with toilets, cafes, vending machines, and staff rooms.

core
uses

Service queues

Patients queue at rooms while their health falls; untreated patients die, and long waits lower satisfaction.

core
uses

Staff hiring and rosters

Doctors, nurses, janitors, and assistants come with personality traits and specialisations that change performance; wages and morale must be managed.

core
uses

Advertising and awareness

Assistants in the marketing room run paid campaigns that draw more patients, optionally targeted at specific illnesses.

supporting
uses

Agent skills

Staff earn qualifications in the training room that unlock or improve tasks.

supporting
uses

Contagion

Later levels bring epidemics with a limited vaccine supply; immunizing every infected patient earns a reward.

supporting
